Description: Centralized control of HVAC, lighting and access systems.
Ingests live telemetry from facility IoT sensors.
Pulls interval energy consumption data from smart meters.
Sends alert and report emails to configured recipients.
Sends critical alerts via SMS gateway.
Posts alerts and daily summaries to a Teams channel.
Synchronizes work orders and cost data with the ERP.
Provides weather data used for energy forecasting.
Backs up reports and exports to cloud storage.
General purpose REST endpoint for third-party access.
